description: This file is a CMake script defining a function 'dfs_callback' that performs a depth-first traversal over a data structure (maps and lists), emitting events and handling visited nodes. It is used for parsing or processing nested data structures with callbacks.

methods.name: dfs_callback
methods.description: The main function that initiates a depth-first traversal of a nested data structure, calling a user-provided callback for each event (e.g., list start/end, map start/end).

methods.name: dfs_callback_inner
methods.description: An inner recursive helper function that performs depth-first traversal of a node, emitting events and tracking visited nodes to handle references.

methods.name: dfs_callback_emit
methods.description: A local function (defined dynamically) that calls the user-provided callback with specific event data.
